title: Full Theta dialogue file (FT-DAT-003, FT-DAT-004)
description: One file per group; each spoken line has a stable id shared by subtitles, translations and TTS. tools/check_dialogue.py also checks what a schema can't: ids unique across files and prefixed by the file name, and each language's text using exactly the declared slots.

id.description: Stable line id: lowercase, dot-separated, first part the file name. Never derived from the text; renaming one is a content change.

role.description: Voice role (content/voices.json); computer lines get the robotic filter (FT-AUD-004).

priority.description: P0 critical alarm, P1 ship computer, P2 NPC radio, P3 ambient (spec 9.3).

max_age_ms.description: A queued line older than this is dropped (FT-AUD-008).

coalesce.description: Coalescing key; a newer queued line with the same key supersedes this one. May use {slot}.

resume.description: After preemption: true resumes the line, false drops it.

slots.description: Values filled at runtime: closed-set names from the Start cache, numbers from fragments (D101).

feminine.description: Languages in which the counted noun is feminine (pt_PT duas, it una).

intent.description: binding slots: the IntentTable id whose binding the client shows (Shakedown steps). A binding slot is text-only: never voiced, never prerendered; the client fills it with the player's current binding (FT-MIS-039).
